caption: The drawing depicts a set of balance scales suspended above a rounded, flat, reddish pedestal. The scales consist of a horizontal gold bar with a central vertical support and pointer, and two gold strings or wires hanging down to support circular brown pans on either side. Each pan has a dark brown geometric shape placed on it. The pedestal below the scales is reddish-orange with a yellow or gold design featuring an eagle and laurel leaves in the center. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or patterns. The artist's name, "Lon Crane," appears in small text near the bottom right of the image.
title: Shaker Scales
